labelStatus: Authored fictional acceptance expectations, not participant labels or independent validation
basis: F01, F02, F03, B01 and C01 reuse the intent boundaries in trial-cases.json. Other cases exercise retrieval and project eligibility without inference.

metrics.expectedHitAt3: Cases with at least one expected practice and at least one of those practices in the final surfaced top three, divided by cases with a nonempty expected set.
metrics.excludedSuggestion: Cases where any excluded practice appears in the final surfaced top three, divided by cases with an excluded practice.
metrics.limitations: No calibrated targets are claimed. Empty expected sets test abstention separately. These cases do not measure source truth, human usefulness or JEV.

cases.title: Feature with acceptance missing
cases.brief: Build a status filter for the support request list. Reuse the screen and make the smallest necessary change. Agree acceptance scenarios before implementation. Do not create or maintain a project wiki.

cases.title: Acceptance supplied in the current recipe
cases.brief: Build a status filter for the existing request list. Reuse the screen. Do not add a maintained wiki.

answers.acceptance: Open hides Closed requests. All shows every request. An empty result shows a clear message.

cases.title: Explicit no wiki boundary
cases.brief: Make the smallest necessary change to the existing request list. Do not create or maintain a project wiki.

cases.title: Scoped bug repair
cases.brief: Repair the status filter. Expected: Open hides Closed requests. Observed: both remain visible. Reuse existing code and make the smallest necessary change. Do not add a maintained wiki.

cases.title: Conflicting acceptance stays visible
cases.brief: Build the status filter with requirements linked to implementation. Do not create a wiki.

answers.acceptance: Reviewer A says hide Closed requests. Reviewer B says keep Closed visible. No decision has been made.

cases.title: Source backed project wiki
cases.brief: Create a source backed project wiki with original source anchors, maintained summaries and recorded corrections.

cases.title: Negative source backed wiki request
cases.brief: Do not create a source backed project wiki.

cases.title: Validated retrieval through an API
cases.brief: Retrieve matching topics through the approved API and validate scope, empty, invalid and unavailable results before using the information.

cases.title: Shared repository instructions
cases.brief: Keep one short AGENTS.md with repository commands, conventions and boundaries for coding agents.

cases.title: Already selected wiki is not offered again
cases.brief: Maintain a source backed project wiki. Keep repository instructions for coding agents in AGENTS.md.

cases.title: GitHub Actions is reading, not a practice to select
cases.brief: Add a request status filter and make pipeline tests pass before release. Reuse the smallest coherent change.

cases.title: Duplicate technology facts do not change rank
cases.brief: Make the smallest necessary change and run CI checks.

cases.title: Short technology identifiers remain usable
cases.brief: Make the smallest necessary change to a Go service and check CI. Do not add a wiki.

cases.title: No chosen development workflow
cases.brief: Plan a flight and hotel for a holiday.
